name: ssi-events-api
description: Backend API for events.ssistudios.com (AWS Lambda + DynamoDB)

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --external:sharp --sourcemap=inline "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./dist/index.mjs'); if (typeof m.handler !== 'function') throw new Error('handler missing'); console.log('bundle loads')"
